provenance: Related by Larry in a phone call with his son on August 12, 2026; noted down by his son the same day. Working notes: research/interviews/2026-08-12-call-notes.md.
text: Larry was about a month into basic training when Kennedy was shot.
researchNotes: Kennedy was assassinated November 22, 1963. Counted from Larry's induction on October 28, 1963 (DD-214, item 18), "about a month into basic training" is a match within days — his own unprompted memory independently corroborates the form's 1963 induction date over the old family estimate of 1964. The location of basic training is still unknown; ask.
